constraints: Childcare drop-off and pick-up events stay in place and the public-transport legs are timed to reach them on time.
The client demo is protected, and the office-to-school trip starts immediately after it with only a five-minute buffer before pick-up.
The hardware test is added at the office before the demo, displacing lower-priority flexible work today.
The dentist appointment is not moved, and home-to-dentist public transport is scheduled for the stated 35 minutes.
Fixed commute events are changed only where the confirmed car breakdown makes the original car-based plan infeasible.
Thursday is planned as work from home, using the user's stated flexibility and avoiding an unnecessary office trip.
Marta's swimming is skipped because the no-car route would be late and would compress dinner and bedtime.
Online groceries depend on delivery availability, so the slot should be confirmed with the supermarket.
School-to-home travel is assumed to take the same 35 minutes as home-to-school travel.
priorities: Keep both children on-time for school, daycare and collection.
Keep the office hardware test and the client demo today.
Keep the dentist appointment tomorrow.
Use partner availability only where already on the calendar, and confirm no-car pickup logistics for Thursday.
Protect dinner and bedtime as much as possible after the disrupted travel.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the partner to do Wednesday morning drop-off.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Rejected because the user still needs a known school-to-office route for the office hardware test, and home-to-office travel is unknown.

alternatives_considered.option: Use an authorised adult or taxi for Wednesday pick-up.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Keep as backup only, because the proposed office-to-school trip arrives on time but has little delay margin.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep Marta's swimming class.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Rejected because the school-to-pool route has no direct bus and would make the evening unnecessarily tight.

alternatives_considered.option: Go to the office on Thursday.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Rejected because working from home better preserves the dentist appointment and avoids unknown no-car office logistics.

alternatives_considered.option: Do in-store groceries by bus.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Rejected because the calendar notes heavy groceries by bus are impractical without the car.

rationale.summary: The plan switches the school and office trips to public transport, keeps today's hardware test and client demo, works from home tomorrow, preserves the dentist appointment, skips swimming, and replaces in-store groceries with an online delivery slot that still needs confirmation.
